title: Buddy Petit and the Entertainers Club
summary: He did not play with Buddy Petit or Chris Kelly but met musicians and jammed at the Entertainers Club near Canal Street.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Do you ever play with Buddy Petillo, Chris Kelly, Rene?
No, I didn't say play in their band, but I remember Buddy around here and when I was in Florida and I first went there, he had been and left and he went to Montgomery.

I remember very well back in 24. He had been out in Pensacola. But like I say, this place, the club, the entertainment club, all the musicians used to hide me around there and you'd meet all those guys. You know, sometimes we'd sit in and jam and play together, you know.
Where was that? The entertainment club?
That was, I really call that cruise out. That's right behind Krauss Stuhl.
Yeah, in New Orleans. The old 25 was right in that channel. It was one block going down Canal Street.
The big 25, is that the place?
Yeah, the original 25 was right on the corner. And the entertainment was right on the, well on the, going across the street corner like, yeah.
